source.evidence: Editable/sliced geometry reviewed. Printer internal cache readback matched the sliced archive SHA-256. Printer accepted plate 1, archive MD5 35E1FAB72A9734CB212C4AC6A98E6DDF, and both AMS mappings. Exact job observed RUNNING at 10:42:41 UTC. A direct status check first observed FINISH at 19:33:27 UTC, with 713/713 layers and no active error. Exact finish time and deposited mass were unavailable.

notes: Textured PEI, 0.15 mm layers, 15% infill and a 5 mm outer brim. Estimated 95.17 g black PLA and 2.96 g PVA. The owner confirmed the bed marks were glue. Printer completion observed. Support cleanup, engraved label and physical fit remain unverified.
